description.machine_max.blueprint.ae86: The AE86 is a compact, lightweight, economy-oriented car produced by Toyota, introduced in 1983 as the fourth-generation Corolla. Toyota's launch of the TERCEL in 1978 marked the beginning of a shift in small cars from the simple but costly and space-consuming FR (front-engine, rear-wheel drive) layout to the more complex but cost-effective FF (front-engine, front-wheel drive) layout, driven by advances in automotive technology.
description.machine_max.blueprint.ae86at: This AE86 has been modified with a four-wheel drive system, a more powerful engine, a compatible transmission, and all-terrain tires, greatly enhancing its off-road capability.
description.machine_max.blueprint.mini_e: The Hongguang miniEV is the first four-seat new energy vehicle under the Wuling brand of SAIC-GM-Wuling, officially launched on July 24, 2020. It focuses on short-distance convenient travel scenarios, striving to become the 'people's mobility scooter'.
description.machine_max.blueprint.jeep: The Jeep Wrangler is a classic off-road vehicle from the Jeep brand, known for its powerful off-road performance and rugged body structure, suitable for driving in various complex terrains.
description.machine_max.blueprint.dayun: The Dayun Heavy Truck is a heavy-duty truck produced by China's Dayun Automobile, featuring strong load capacity and reliable performance, widely used in logistics transportation and construction projects.
description.machine_max.blueprint.wine_f: The Wine Fox Car is a uniquely designed small urban commuter vehicle with a fashionable and cute appearance, suitable for short-distance travel in cities.
The Wine Fox Car is a uniquely designed small urban commuter vehicle with a fashionable and cute appearance, with a better performance after upgrading.
description.machine_max.blueprint.kluo: KLUO Car is a classic-style compact oil-to-electric sedan. Despite its limited range, its acceleration capability and top speed should not be underestimated.
description.machine_max.blueprint.kluo_g: KLUO Car is a classic-style compact oil-to-electric sedan. With the GT upgrade package, handling and track capability are further improved.
description.machine_max.blueprint.r700: The Pathfinder R700 is a multi-functional off-road vehicle designed specifically for exploration and outdoor activities, featuring good passability and reliability.
description.machine_max.blueprint.senna_: The McLaren Senna GTR is an extreme track-focused supercar featuring advanced aerodynamic design, including a large rear wing, diffuser, and front splitter. These elements generate enormous downforce at high speeds, ensuring exceptional stability and handling. Its lightweight construction and powerful powertrain make it a true king on the racetrack.
description.machine_max.blueprint.van: This van may be inexpensive, but with outstanding reliability and practicality, it has become a loyal partner for countless families starting small businesses. It does not chase looks, only capacity. Its battle-tested chassis and powertrain keep moving forward under heavy loads in both cities and rural roads. This humble van has carried building materials, freight, and hope, helping many ordinary people earn their first bucket of gold. It is not a race car, but in the hearts of strivers, it is still the fastest lap toward a better life.
description.machine_max.blueprint.szn: The Sovereign is a heavy all-terrain assault vehicle that roams the cyber metropolis of the future. Developed by the munitions division of a giant tech oligopoly, it ended up as the core equipment the resistance uses to break blockades. Its aggressive angle-cut bodywork carries a widened roll cage and a full-length neon energy fairing, while fluorescent cyan-green rings are set into the outer face of all four off-road hubs and stand out sharply in dim alleys. Matte white armour covers the body, the core power bay leaves its wine-red alloy frame exposed, and concealed side heat grilles complete the layout; the aerodynamic shaping both splits the airflow at speed and provides structural support on broken ground.
description.machine_max.blueprint.vn: The Purge is a classified high-speed motorcycle born in the shadows of the cyber metropolis. Built by a research division under the giant tech oligopoly, it ultimately became the blade of the resistance. Its aggressive low-slung streamlined form is built on matte black nano-alloy, with key structures covered by bright white armour panels and cold pink-purple glowing rims and body lines standing out in the dark. An integrated front fairing with side heat grilles, together with a retractable aerodynamic tail wing, holds steady downforce at cruising speed. Two-wheel drive on both sides of the body and a lightweight carbon-fibre frame let it weave through the narrow alleys between skyscrapers and still explode with startling power when chasing or breaking out — the ideal mount for a resister slipping through the neon rain.
description.machine_max.blueprint.santan: Shanghai Volkswagen's classic Santana, widely known in China as the Pusang. Its square front and clean, understated lines were once many people's idea of a passenger car. On April 11, 1983, workers hand-assembled the first Santana in Anting, Shanghai; after Shanghai Volkswagen was founded in 1985, localization and series production gradually followed. Its famous slogan, 'Own a Santana, travel the world without worry,' became part of an era's memory.
